headline: Millersville score a dozen before conference play opens
dek: Millersville have scored twelve and conceded three, and both of the season's box-score gaps are theirs: the site holds those scores and not the shape of them. Slippery Rock and West Chester have yet to score, and Pitt-Johnstown have yet to play.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The conference's goals are stacked at one end: Millersville have outscored Bloomsburg and Seton Hill together, while at the other end Pitt-Johnstown, Slippery Rock and West Chester have no goal to draw.

wire.line: Pitt-Johnstown are the only side yet to play a match on the record.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: E. Stroudsburg's season opener against Mercer County is the season's one score gap, a final with no published score, and five further dates have passed with no result at all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have no played match on the record. Their dates at Shippensburg and at Mount Aloysius have passed with no result, and they play at Chestnut Hill tonight.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: California (Pa.) have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme has let in, and scored five.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Bloomsburg's seven goals have come from six different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd are unbeaten, with Aidan Houck making fifteen saves and conceding twice across their matches.

last_match.line: Millersville have won at home and away; California (Pa.) have yet to keep a clean sheet.

next_match.line: Pitt-Johnstown have no match on the record yet; earlier dates passed without a published result.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
